title: Face rigging for a reconstructed head

queue.claim: Jaw rig priors: the mandibular condyle (jaw pivot) sits about 10–15 mm in front of and 0–10 mm below tragion, 15–20 mm deep. In adults the first ~20–25 mm of mouth opening is mostly rotation; at maximum opening (40–60 mm) the jaw has rotated about 20–30° and the condyle has slid forward about 10–20 mm.

queue.claim: Live Link Face in ARKit mode streams and records 61 values: the 52 ARKit blendshapes plus head yaw/pitch/roll and left/right eye yaw/pitch/roll. It sends over UDP (default port 11111) and records a timecoded CSV with the same columns.
queue.query: Live Link Face CSV columns Timecode BlendshapeCount HeadYaw LeftEyeYaw 61 port 11111

queue.claim: Blender 4.4 introduced slotted Actions, and from 4.4 on F-curves are written through layers, strips and channelbags. The legacy Action.fcurves API was deprecated and then removed in Blender 5.0.

queue.claim: Rigify still ships with Blender (4.2+/5.x). Its face has been a modular 'skin' system since Blender 3.0 (lid, lip, brow and nose chains with glue bones, plus jaw, eye and tongue rigs), with an 'Upgrade Face Rig' converter for the legacy super_face.
